title: Targeted mRNA Therapy for Osteoarthritis Using Disease‑Responsive Nanoparticles
summary: Researchers developed disease‑responsive nanoparticles in mouse models that home to damaged cartilage and deliver mRNA therapy precisely where osteoarthritis is most severe, offering a new strategy for targeted, lesion‑specific treatment.The postTargeted mRNA Therapy for Osteoarthritis Using Disease‑Responsive Nanoparticlesappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
